# AbstractContinuum

> Continuous iterative development and deployment console for
> AbstractFramework (npm: `@abstractframework/continuum`, CLI:
> `abstractcontinuum`, version 0.2.0): a thin React client over a Run
> Gateway's development-lane APIs — kanban board, live execution pipeline
> (executor-agnostic; Codex CLI today), backlog catalog, agora hub Team
> page, report/email triage, and managed prod/UAT service control.
> High-trust surface: a signed-in user can redeploy services (see
> SECURITY.md).

Run it with `npx @abstractframework/continuum` against a gateway
(`ABSTRACTCONTINUUM_GATEWAY_URL`, default `http://127.0.0.1:8080`); it
serves on `http://127.0.0.1:3002`.

- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): sign-in, executions, inbox, processes, Team page, dev setup

## Source Map

- bin/cli.js: CLI server — static serving, gateway session proxy, hub proxy mount
- bin/hub_proxy.js: allowlisted agora hub proxy (HTTP + WebSocket)
- src/lib/gateway_client.ts: typed gateway client (dev-lane families only)
- src/lib/hub_client.ts: agora hub client; vendor/hub/ holds the pinned hub contract
- src/ui/board/: kanban board; src/ui/backlog/: backlog + exec pipeline (model.ts is pure + unit-pinned)
- src/ui/team_page.tsx: Team page; src/ui/executions_page.tsx, agents_page.tsx, report_inbox.tsx, email_inbox.tsx, processes_page.tsx: other pages
